en: A psalm; a song for the Sabbath day.

he: ט֗וֹב לְהֹד֥וֹת לַיהֹוָ֑ה וּלְזַמֵּ֖ר לְשִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
en: It is good to give thanks to Havayah, and to sing to Your name, Most High.
To declare Your kindness in the morning, and Your faithfulness in the nights.
Upon the ten-stringed, and upon the lyre; upon meditation with the harp.

he: כִּ֤י שִׂמַּחְתַּ֣נִי יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּפׇעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃
en: For You have gladdened me, Havayah, with Your doing; at the works of Your hands I shall sing.

he: מַה־גָּדְל֣וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֣יךָ יְהֹוָ֑ה מְ֝אֹ֗ד עָמְק֥וּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
en: How great are Your works, Havayah; how deep are Your thoughts.

he: אִֽישׁ־בַּ֭עַר לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וּ֝כְסִ֗יל לֹא־יָבִ֥ין אֶת־זֹֽאת׃
en: A brutish man does not know, and a fool does not understand this.

he: בִּפְרֹ֤חַ רְשָׁעִ֨ים ׀ כְּמ֥וֹ־עֵ֗שֶׂב וַ֭יָּצִיצוּ כׇּל־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן לְהִשָּׁמְדָ֥ם עֲדֵי־עַֽד׃
en: When the wicked sprout like grass, and all workers of iniquity blossom — it is to be destroyed forever.
But You are on high forever, Havayah.

he: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אֹיְבֶ֡יךָ יְֽהֹוָ֗ה כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה אֹיְבֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ יִ֝תְפָּרְד֗וּ כׇּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
en: For behold, Your enemies, Havayah — for behold, Your enemies shall perish; all workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

he: וַתָּ֣רֶם כִּרְאֵ֣ים קַרְנִ֑י בַּ֝לֹּתִ֗י בְּשֶׁ֣מֶן רַעֲנָֽן׃
en: And You lift my horn like a wild ox's; I am anointed with fresh oil.

he: וַתַּבֵּ֥ט עֵינִ֗י בְּשׁ֫וּרָ֥י בַּקָּמִ֖ים עָלַ֥י מְרֵעִ֗ים תִּשְׁמַ֥עְנָה אׇזְנָֽי׃
en: And my eye has looked upon my watchers; of the evildoers who rise against me, my ears shall hear.

he: צַ֭דִּיק כַּתָּמָ֣ר יִפְרָ֑ח כְּאֶ֖רֶז בַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן יִשְׂגֶּֽה׃
en: The righteous shall flourish like a palm; like a cedar in the Levanon he shall grow.

he: שְׁ֭תוּלִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה בְּחַצְר֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ יַפְרִֽיחוּ׃
en: Planted in the house of Havayah, they shall blossom in the courtyards of our Elokim.

he: ע֭וֹד יְנוּב֣וּן בְּשֵׂיבָ֑ה דְּשֵׁנִ֖ים וְֽרַעֲנַנִּ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ׃
en: They shall still bear fruit in old age; fat and fresh they shall be.

he: לְ֭הַגִּיד כִּֽי־יָשָׁ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה צ֝וּרִ֗י וְֽלֹא־[עַוְלָ֥תָה] (עלתה) בּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
en: To declare that Havayah is upright, my Rock; and there is no injustice in Him.
